item.billys-mods.viltrumite_genome.descr: Grants Viltrumite strength and durability, plus self-propelled flight while carried.
item.billys-mods.viltrumite_genome.fligh: G toggles flight. Hold Control to accelerate into a high-speed boost. Backward flight is slower and stays out of the Superman pose. Forward and backward follow your look angle; jump and sneak add vertical thrust. Keys are configurable in Controls.
